steps.label: CHECK RANDOMIZATION FIRST
steps.sub: Report effect size + 95% CI, never a bare p

code:
rng = np.random.default_rng(2024)
p_churn = np.where(treat==1, 0.20, 0.24)   # true rates: 20% vs 24%
df["churned"] = rng.binomial(1, p_churn)
base = rng.lognormal(3.6, 0.7, n) * np.sqrt((df.prior_sessions+1)/7)
df["spend"] = (base * (1 + 0.03*treat)).round(2)
caption: Spend right-skewed, grows with prior activity. ~2% of ages deliberately missing.

code:
print(df.shape)                      # (5000, 7)
print(df.isna().sum().to_dict())     # age: 100 missing (2%)
print(df.group.value_counts().to_dict())  # 2500 / 2500
print(round(df.spend.skew(),2))      # 2.61
print(df.spend.median(), df.spend.mean())  # 36.22  46.82
caption: Overall churn ~21%. Mean well above median -- spend is strongly right-skewed.
